summary.one_line: The DLL-only wiki instructions and five-battle evidence are accurate, scoped and bilingual.

purpose.evidence: Read all 16 review:info documentation paths plus the new JSON and crypt image. The wiki now explains DLL-only ordinary Heroes/Lobby startup for both mods, distinguishes player setup from developer diagnostics, records the delivery correction in the diary and exposes bounded run evidence. It says player archives remain unpublished rather than treating source ZIPs as ready mods.

structure.evidence: README/AGENTS lead with the delivery correction; player predictor/bank pages replace separate-EXE steps with bin/dinput8.dll and bin/Heroes5Mods paths, mod catalog summarizes availability, devkit/native-UI pages link the shared mechanism, and llms.txt points to the current DLL model. A new dated diary entry preserves older EXE-era observations without rewriting them. NOTICE describes the screenshot/JSON provenance; pages link those canonical artifacts rather than duplicating raw logs.

specificity.evidence: Independently parsed docs/assets/preview/dll-checks-2026-09-25.json: pack_8 3/3, pack_12 4/4, pack_15 1/7, pack_0 0/2 and pack_1 1/1 exact cell matches. The diary table and predictor wording agree, including one predicted stack becoming two. JSON records auto_load true, separate_native_loader false, after-Start observations, a missing-bank-H5U failure with exit code 1114, and a crypt capture at 1264x921. The crypt PNG SHA-256 is 18beb8c79f7e627a52ecf9e5a510653a15be8f5f01cf4d4fcc762af1f9d4279e, matching diary; visual inspection shows separate A/B rows.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports website 8 Node, 23 Python, 41 HTML and 13 browser checks passing. The diary links the public JSON and screenshot so readers can check the stated summary; NOTICE says these are extracted results, not complete private logs. The new player DLL packages are not yet published, so pages do not offer an unavailable release link or promise immediate player reproduction. I did not launch a game; parent supplied the live menu/status3, both-DLL/status7, five-battle and exit1114 checks.

evidence.evidence: The wiki's claims are narrower than its evidence: five cycles demonstrate startup/card/cleanup, not five exact predictions; pack_15 and pack_0 failures are visible. The crypt image is labeled an actual client-area screenshot after removing the legacy text H5U, and the diary records that failure of the old package. Source code for dinput8 and both mod DLLs was reviewed separately; this site review checked public summary/artifacts and did not independently re-run binary hooks. Game hashes are described as compatibility checks, not plugin authenticity.

applicability.evidence: The pages target the pinned Universe build, ordinary Heroes/Lobby startup, one shared dinput8.dll and optional known mod DLLs. They warn against overwriting foreign dinput8, explain bank H5U pairing and old text-package conflict, and remove mod-specific DLL/H5U files separately during uninstall. They retain limits on other arenas, banks, display sizes, localizations and physical RMB; the Heroes/Lobby UI itself was not automated. Current delivery is unreleased.

translations.evidence: Compared RU/EN player pages, devkit/native-UI notes, diary, README/AGENTS and NOTICE: both languages give the same DLL/H5U paths, ordinary-start rule, no separate player EXE, no-public-download state, five-battle table, 1/7 and 0/2 accuracy limits, crypt 1264x921 evidence, missing-H5U exit1114 and scope caveats. llms.txt remains a bilingual pointer to canonical sources. No material translation mismatch found.

maintenance.evidence: AGENTS requires synchronized README, RU/EN wiki, devkit, mod guides and release notes for delivery changes. This diff updates all site entry points while retaining the historical repository-split diary entry and appending a dated correction. The new JSON and screenshot have explicit provenance and links; proprietary game archives/profiles/raw logs are not published. review:info lists exactly 16 documentation paths covered here; no source file was edited by this reviewer.
